CustomField.description: The Gravity Forms entry id for this submission. UNIQUE and an external id - this is what makes the endpoint idempotent. Gravity Forms retries on failure, and without this a retry would create a second gift. The endpoint inserts and catches the duplicate error rather than querying first, so the guest user needs only Create permission. Website Donations phase 1 / Jason Ott.
CustomField.label: Gravity Forms Entry Id
